api_tokens_registry_binding.name: api_tokens_registry_binding
api_tokens_registry_binding.value: "api_tokens"."role" <> 'registry' OR "api_tokens"."session_ref" IS NOT NULL OR "api_tokens"."run_id" IS NOT NULL

messages_owner_principal.name: messages_owner_principal
messages_owner_principal.value: "messages"."author" <> 'owner' OR "messages"."device_session_id" IS NOT NULL OR "messages"."owner_id" IS NOT NULL

task_decisions_actor.name: task_decisions_actor
task_decisions_actor.value: ("task_decisions"."actor_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("task_decisions"."engineer_run_id" IS NOT NULL)

task_decisions_physical.name: task_decisions_physical
task_decisions_physical.value: ("task_decisions"."kind" = 'physical_decision' AND "task_decisions"."actor_id" IS NULL AND "task_decisions"."outbox_id" IS NULL AND "task_decisions"."delivery_state" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'applied') OR ("task_decisions"."kind" IS DISTINCT FROM 'physical_decision' AND "task_decisions"."outbox_id" IS NOT NULL)

task_decisions_revision.name: task_decisions_revision
task_decisions_revision.value: "task_decisions"."kind" NOT IN ('approve','reject','request_changes','resolve_block','revise_requirements') OR "task_decisions"."revision_number" IS NOT NULL

registry_results_difference.name: registry_results_difference
registry_results_difference.value: "registry_inquiry_results"."verdict" IS NULL OR "registry_inquiry_results"."verdict" = 'applies' OR "registry_inquiry_results"."difference" IS NOT NULL

registry_results_conflict.name: registry_results_conflict
registry_results_conflict.value: "registry_inquiry_results"."verdict" IS DISTINCT FROM 'conflict' OR "registry_inquiry_results"."conflicts_with_id" IS NOT NULL

generated.as: to_tsvector('russian'::regconfig, coalesce(problem,'') || ' ' || coalesce(decision,'') || ' ' || coalesce(exceptions_text,'') || ' ' || coalesce(grounds,'') || ' ' || coalesce(consequences,'') || ' ' || coalesce(question,'') || ' ' || coalesce(summary,''))

to_tsvector('english'::regconfig, coalesce(problem,'') || ' ' || coalesce(decision,'') || ' ' || coalesce(exceptions_text,'') || ' ' || coalesce(grounds,'') || ' ' || coalesce(consequences,'') || ' ' || coalesce(question,'') || ' ' || coalesce(summary,''))

registry_records_right.name: registry_records_right
registry_records_right.value: ("registry_records"."kind" = 'permission' AND af_0007_valid_right("registry_records"."right") IS TRUE) OR ("registry_records"."kind" IS DISTINCT FROM 'permission' AND "registry_records"."right" IS NULL)

right_grants_subject.name: right_grants_subject
right_grants_subject.value: "right_grants"."task_id" IS NOT NULL OR "right_grants"."session_ref" IS NOT NULL

right_requests_subject.name: right_requests_subject
right_requests_subject.value: "right_requests"."task_id" IS NOT NULL OR "right_requests"."session_ref" IS NOT NULL

tasks_origin_required.name: tasks_origin_required
tasks_origin_required.value: "tasks"."origin_type" NOT IN ('decomposition','agent_proposal') OR ("tasks"."origin_task_id" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."origin_run_id" IS NOT NULL)
